frontend-developer.description: React (Vite) SPA frontend only — route components, the API client, React Router, and forms. Never touches backend code.
frontend-developer.lsp_trace: a component or hook to its definition

context: Frontend source lives in `<% frontend.src_dir %>`; route components live under `<% frontend.route_dir %>`
This is a client-rendered SPA — there is no server runtime and no Server Components
The `@/*` path alias maps to `<% frontend.src_dir %>`; import with `@/lib/api`, not deep relative paths
rules: Never call the database or import backend code from a component — go through the API client
The Vite tsconfig enables `erasableSyntaxOnly` — do not use TS parameter properties, enums or namespaces; declare class fields explicitly

scaffold.$comment: VERIFICATION NOTE: scaffolded and built on Node 22.16 (Jul 2026). create-vite ships React 19.2 / Vite 8.1 / TS 6.0. Config files are staged under .claude-kit/scaffold via pre-conventions and copied into apps/web AFTER create-vite but BEFORE the ui-kit step, because shadcn init (a ui-kit command) needs the Vite config, Tailwind and the @/* alias already present — post-conventions run too late. TS 6.0 deprecates baseUrl, so tsconfig.app.json uses paths without it; the root tsconfig carries baseUrl+paths (it has files:[] so no deprecation) solely so shadcn resolves @ to src. The Vite tsconfig also enables erasableSyntaxOnly (no TS parameter properties).

commands.note: create-vite needs the parent dir to exist

commands.run: npm --prefix apps/web install react-router-dom tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite react-hook-form zod @hookform/resolvers

cp .claude-kit/scaffold/react-vite/vite.config.ts apps/web/vite.config.ts && cp .claude-kit/scaffold/react-vite/tsconfig.json apps/web/tsconfig.json && cp .claude-kit/scaffold/react-vite/tsconfig.app.json apps/web/tsconfig.app.json && cp .claude-kit/scaffold/react-vite/index.css apps/web/src/index.css
commands.note: overwrite create-vite defaults with the Tailwind + @/* alias config the ui-kit step depends on
